description: The bar chart compares the performance of three different strategies for mitigating hallucinations in text-to-SQL generation: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). The horizontal axis represents the two evaluation metrics: Recall and F1 Score. The vertical axis is a scale from 40 to 100, indicating the percentage scores for each metric. For Recall, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) has a score of 63.58, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 71.90, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 72.29. For the F1 Score, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) has a score of 75.34, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 80.40, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 81.08. The bars are color-coded with DIN-SQL (zero-shot) in light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) in dark blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) in green. The chart shows that the DIN-SQL (few-shot) strategy outperforms the other two in both Recall and F1 Score, with the highest scores in both categories.
